instructions.en: For each activity, choose the state that describes an example you can currently recall. Recent means within the past 12 months; older means before that. An example can come from work, study, volunteering, a hobby or everyday life, and its outcome may have been helpful, mixed or unhelpful. Do not judge its quality or rate your ability. If you have no example but want to explore the activity, choose that option. Otherwise use not relevant, cannot judge or prefer not to answer. You do not enter an example, upload a file or disclose another person’s information. The page records only your selected state; it never verifies the event or the quality of a skill.
instructions.zh: 逐项选择目前能回想的实例状态。“近期”指过去12个月，“更早”指这之前。实例可来自工作、学习、志愿活动、爱好或日常生活，结果可以有用、好坏参半或没有帮助。不评价实例质量，也不为自己的能力打分。没有实例但愿意了解这项活动时选相应选项，其他情况可选不相关、无法判断或暂不回答。无需输入实例、上传文件或披露他人信息；页面只记录所选状态，不核实事件或技能质量。
